model.description: LLM model to use for this job

template.description: Template name for generating the job prompt

depends_on.description: List of job IDs that must complete before this job runs

include.description: Files or globs to include as context in the job prompt

source_block.description: Reference to a named block in another job to use as input

source_file.description: Path to source file for context

repository.description: Git repository URL for worktree creation

inline.description: Controls which content types are inlined vs uploaded

on_complete_status.description: Status to set on dependent jobs when this job completes

updated_at.description: When the job was last modified

source_plan.description: Reference to the plan this job was generated from

recipe_name.description: Name of the recipe used to create this job

generate_plan_from.description: Generate a new plan from this job's output

git_changes.description: Include git diff/status in job context

gather_concept_notes.description: Include related concept notes in context

gather_concept_plans.description: Include related concept plans in context

rules_file.description: Path to rules file for agent behavior

used_rules_file.description: Archived rules file used during last execution

note_ref.description: Reference to a notebook entry for context

title: Grove Flow Job
description: Schema for Grove Flow job frontmatter in markdown files.
